doc.title: Eddie Metz Jr. interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, October 3, 2015

title: Rock and roll and the Ride Captain Ride remake
summary: He loved 60s-70s rock and recently recorded a remake of Ride Captain Ride with Blues Image's Mike Pinera.

story.theme_name: In the studio: making records, then and now
story.community_name: Record labels, producers and the business of making albums

blocks.x: the Beatles and, you know, whoever else was popular in the 60s and 70s and I love that music also. In fact I just did a rock & roll record last year.
It’s a remake of “Ride Captain Ride.”

Yeah, Blues Image is one surviving member, Mike Pinera, who wrote that song. So I did this whole new rock & roll record with them. He also was part of Iron Butterfly when they did “In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida.”
Yeah. So this is the official remake. But that’s another part of my career.
But we’re talking about jazz here, so growing up playing standards, learning those songs.
